finding: No static blocker. The patch repairs the absent From<Timestamp> for SystemTime at the test fixture without changing Timestamp or dependencies. Native Cargo/Bazel qualification is pending.
portability: All three test dates and500ms precision are representable by normal Linux/macOS/Windows SystemTime and usual CI filesystems. checked arithmetic avoids unchecked platform overflow; set_times still propagates a genuine filesystem limitation. Cross-platform execution remains unverified.

regression.kind: Behavioral filesystem regression through create_fake_rollout, not an assertion that mirrors the conversion expression.
meaningful_risks_covered: real FileTimes write and metadata read
regression.native_execution: NOT_RUN by reviewer; root owns the combined native gate.
regression.oracle: Read actual file metadata.modified() and compare to independent exact SystemTime constants.

semantics.api: Uses existing public timestamp() and timestamp_subsec_nanos(); does not add or modify a public conversion API.
semantics.leap_second: The existing parser stores :60 as the preceding second with nanoseconds>=1000000000. For 2016-12-31T23:59:60.500Z,1483228799s+1500000000ns maps to POSIX1483228800.5s, preserving the legacy integer-second normalization. Using calendar() directly would discard this extra second.
semantics.negative_fraction: 1969-12-31T23:59:59.500Z is seconds=-1,nanos=500000000; total=-500000000ns, so checked_sub(500ms) preserves the sign and fraction.
semantics.overflow: i64 seconds multiplied by10^9 plus u32 nanoseconds fits i128. The quotient of the unsigned magnitude fits u64, remainder is below10^9 and fits u32. Duration receives normalized fields; checked_add/checked_sub reject SystemTime overflow and the existing anyhow Result propagates conversion and filesystem errors.

wiring.bazel: app-server/tests/common/BUILD.bazel invokes codex_rust_crate(name=common,crate_name=app_test_support,crate_srcs=glob([*.rs])); the new sibling module is included automatically and the macro emits the common-unit-tests target.
wiring.existing_dependencies: pretty_assertions already exists in dev-dependencies; tempfile and anyhow already exist. Cargo.toml is byte-unchanged.
wiring.root_module: lib.rs declares mod rollout; rollout.rs appends cfg(test),path=rollout_tests.rs module.
wiring.workspace_member_via_path_dependency: Workspace app-server declares app_test_support.workspace=true; workspace dependency points to app-server/tests/common; the package is not excluded.
